by: converted (convert1d) from fact_check__1.json and the research's 3 searches

checks.claim: A 90 mile per hour wind pushes about 20 pounds on every square foot.
checks.why: q = 0.00256 x 90^2 = 20.7 psf in the wind pressure tables; it is the basic pressure before code factors.

sources.title: Penn State AE thesis, wind pressure appendix

checks.claim: Footings usually go below the frost line, so frost cannot heave them up.
checks.why: IRC and deck guides require footings below the frost line to prevent heave; some freestanding structures are exempt, so 'usually'.

sources.title: IRC 2021 footing depth and frost line

checks.claim: Paving slabs are laid on a compacted sub-base so they stay flat and drain
checks.why: Wickes and Bradstone both specify a compacted MOT Type 1 sub-base under slabs.

sources.title: How to lay a patio - Wickes
How to lay paving slabs - Bradstone
